thread:
Aisha (Product): FYI inbound from AtlasHealth: need 7yr audit-log retention + BYOK per-tenant (prefer FIPS/HSM). They want this in their contract next quarter. Can we triage MVP scope?

Ravi (Security): Important ask. Clarify: tenant CMEK for audit pipeline vs single envelope key? Also need signed export bundles for chain-of-custody.

Keiko (CS): AtlasHealth says tenant-level keys mandatory and auditors will want a key-escrow handshake. They're strict due to health+finance regs.

Marta (Eng Infra): Feasible. Propose retention buckets: hot 90d (fast search), warm 2y (async search), cold rest to 7y (export-only). Hot/warm indexing cost-ops tradeoffs.

Daniel (SRE): Agree. Cold retrieval job with 24h SLA avoids keeping everything indexed. Need throttles on exports and extra auth for export endpoints.

Owen (Finance): 7y ups storage ~4x. Need pricing uplift and retrieval fees. BYOK HSM adds integration costs.

Aisha (Product): MVP must-haves for contract: 1) tenant BYOK handshake, 2) exportable signed evidence bundle with manifest, 3) retention buckets + SLAs, 4) KMS integration runbook/sample contract language.

Ravi (Security): Add security attestation, rotation policy, and explicit nondisclosure of plaintext post-envelope. FIPS/HSM should be enterprise-gated.

Marta (Eng Infra): Implementation notes: BYOK handshake + periodic attestation, store audit blobs encrypted with tenant CMEK, export API /v1/audit-exports{tenant,start,end,dest} returns signed manifest. Example config: keystore:{tenant_id:"atlas-123",kms_provider:"aws-kms",key_id:"arn:aws:kms:...",escrow:true} retention:{hot_days:90,warm_days:730,cold_days:2555}.

Keiko (CS): Sales needs a one-pager capability matrix (BYOK, export API, retrieval SLA, SOC2 evidence). I'll draft it.

Aisha (Product): Timeline & owners: Ravi: security attestation+threat model due 2025-02-09; Marta: tech design+estimate due 2025-02-05; Daniel: ops runbook+SLA draft due 2025-02-12; Owen: pricing uplift due 2025-01-31; Keiko: contract language + customer liaison due 2025-02-03.

Marta (Eng Infra): Estimate MVP 6w (handshake+backend+export API)+2w runbook/testing. Multi-KMS parity + FIPS add ~3w. I'll open RFC /rfc/byok-audit-retention.

deploy-bot: deployment window request queued; please attach staging test plan and canary thresholds.

Keiko (CS): AtlasHealth responded: tenant keys required; pilot target June and requests compliance one-pager by next Tue.

Aisha (Product): We'll prioritize if AtlasHealth verbally commits. Reconvene Monday to confirm capacity. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
